description: This PHP source file provides the HTML and JavaScript for the 'Add Allowed Device' page in a parental control management system. It includes form elements for selecting devices, configuring access times, and managing user interactions and validation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes page settings including the title and navigation highlighting.

methods.name: updateAllowTimeVisibility
methods.description: Enables or disables time selection inputs based on the 'Always Allow' switch.
